The Camp 8 to Matun-og Falls trail is a 5.72-kilometer point-to-point community route in Minglanilla, passing through farms, local settlements, and the valley leading toward Matun-og Falls. I hiked it in August 2026, starting from Camp 8 and approaching the falls from the opposite direction of the more commonly used Guindaruhan\u2013Taboan\u2013Crasher Site route. <\/p>\n\n\n\n

Although the distance is relatively short, I dealt with repeated climbs and descents along the way. This was my second attempt from Camp 8, and this time I reached Matun-og Falls.<\/p>\n\n\n
